derivation.scope: Actual model cropped to the original 32×16 screen viewport. Source geometry/UVs/normals remain intact. Active phases use authored head yaw (−8, 0, +8 degrees), not recovered animation clips. Boot and static phases only hide sampled source pixels; static B reflects static A horizontally.
derivation.blank: Native frame 7 is transparent, never mapped to an idle pose.
derivation.cellGeometry: All original native cell coordinates are preserved, including the two-pixel overlap in the boot spark.
